rationale: All four round-1 remediation groups are materially implemented: the zero-candidate health probe, beads-derived idle arrival, numeric/full/refusing draft target handling, and real next/impl-adopt AC-14 drives are present and green. Independent probes confirmed the three original gaps. Two adversarial honesty residues remain: mixed active/draft prefix ambiguity can be collapsed to the draft, and an unprotected checkout with a valid draft but no .beads can render idle. Neither path mutates, selects, merges, deletes, or otherwise corrupts a spec branch; under the round-2 instruction to block only on spec-branch-corrupting defects, they are non-blocking follow-up findings.

findings.title: Protected zero-candidate health probe
findings.evidence: handleIdleOrDraft now calls cache.AllEpics before rendering idle when draft discovery returns zero candidates and .beads exists. TestRun_ProtectedCheckout_ZeroDraftCandidates_BdDown_RendersIndeterminate passed. An independent compiled-binary probe on protected main with .beads, zero drafts, and bd absent rendered `MindSpec — Cannot Determine Mode`, not idle.

findings.title: Beads-derived Phase==idle is a draft arrival point
findings.evidence: RunWithOptions now routes ModeIdle through handleIdleOrDraft when .beads exists. The no-draft, one-draft, and multiple-draft tests all passed. An independent unprotected-checkout probe with healthy canned bd output and one draft branch rendered Spec Mode for that draft.

findings.title: Explicit draft --spec forms work, but mixed active/draft ambiguity is fabricated
findings.evidence: The numeric-prefix, full-ID, nonexistent-target refusal, and two-draft ambiguity tests all passed; an independent `--spec 053` draft-only probe rendered the intended draft. A single active `053-*` plus a draft `053-*` correctly selected the active spec. However, with two active `053-*` specs plus one draft `053-*`, ResolveSpecPrefixWithCache returned its generic active-prefix ambiguity error, RunWithOptions entered resolveSpecFlagAgainstDrafts, and the command rendered the lone draft as Active Spec instead of preserving ambiguity. This is newly introduced target fabrication: `mindspec instruct --spec 053` printed Spec Mode for `053-draft-target` while `053-active-a` and `053-active-b` were both active matches.
findings.follow_up: Distinguish active-prefix ambiguity from no-active-match before consulting drafts, or resolve the union of active and draft matches and render ambiguity whenever the combined set is not singular. Add the mixed two-active/one-draft regression case.

findings.title: AC-14 next and impl adopt execution drives
findings.evidence: TestVerbOutput_Next and TestVerbOutput_ImplAdopt now execute the real registered handler/tail paths using a purely canned PATH bd and the existing executor/phase seams, and assert result-before-guidance ordering. Both passed, as did TestVerbOutput_TotalCobraTreeClassification. The former presence-only scope-limitation test is gone.

findings.title: BeadsDirMissing gate can still render idle over a valid draft in an unprotected checkout
findings.evidence: In the no-target fallback, pctx.Phase==idle is sent to handleIdleOrDraft only when !phase.BeadsDirMissing(mainRoot). An independent compiled-binary probe used an unprotected feature checkout with a committed `.mindspec/specs/054-draft-no-beads/spec.md` and local `spec/054-draft-no-beads` branch, but no .beads and no bd. `mindspec instruct` rendered `MindSpec — No Active Work`. Thus the gate correctly preserves idle for a truly empty uninitialized workspace, but it also hides a discoverable draft when tracker initialization/state is unavailable.
findings.follow_up: When .beads is absent, cheaply enumerate draft candidates first. Preserve idle only when no candidate exists; if a valid spec branch/spec file exists but its epic status cannot be checked, render indeterminate rather than idle.

findings.title: Build, suite, and hygiene
findings.evidence: At reviewed commit 3c472ac9dd16df96666539535918d1609e404c29, all eight new internal/instruct arrival tests passed; the targeted AC-14 tests passed; `go build -buildvcs=false ./...` passed; and `go test -buildvcs=false ./... -short` passed. The bead worktree was clean and byte-identical after review. All /tmp probe repositories and the temporary Go build cache were deleted.
